text:
jordan: Quick FYI — found a mismatch between the Python streaming snippet and the TS example in the pagination guide. Python uses `stream=True` but the TS shows a single response path. Can we align?

sara: thanks for catching. where is the source file? link? :eyes: 

jordan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — the Python sample was updated in that PR, TS one was untouched.

ben: pinging to sync. I can update the TS snippet to show async iterator style. want me to open a follow-up PR?

ellie: if we change TS, also check Go example for the cursor handling. we had a bug where the Go sample swallowed retry headers.

mike: i can take Go. can someone paste the current snippets here?

jordan: Python snippet in PR 4321 (shortened):
```python
resp = client.responses.create(model="rwd-4x", input=prompt, stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.delta)
```

sara: TS current in docs: (non-streaming)
```ts
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-4x', input: prompt });
console.log(resp.output_text);
```

ben: suggest this TS streaming async-iter pattern:
```ts
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-4x', input: prompt });
for await (const patch of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(patch.delta ?? '');
}
```

ellie: Go sample needs both cursor pagination and retry example. current snippet looks like:
```go
resp, _ := client.Responses.Create(ctx, CreateOptions{Model: "rwd-4x", Input: prompt})
fmt.Println(resp.OutputText)
```

ellie: that swallowed the Retry-After logic. propose: show a small backoff loop + page cursor handling.

mike: rough Go draft I'll push to a branch:
```go
cursor := ""
for {
  res, err := client.Responses.List(ctx, ListOpts{Cursor: cursor})
  if err != nil {
    wait := backoff.Next()
    time.Sleep(wait)
    continue
  }
  for _, r := range res.Items {
    fmt.Println(r.Text)
  }
  if res.NextCursor == "" { break }
  cursor = res.NextCursor
}
```

jordan: perfect. also add a small note in each snippet about idempotency and safe retries for streaming endpoints (e.g., re-attach or resume via KV cache header).

sara: agree. docs-bot can remind authors to add a test snippet. @docs-bot any template for change log?

docs-bot: Suggested checklist: 1) Update TS streaming sample, 2) Update Go example with cursor+retry, 3) Add one-line note about resume behavior, 4) Add cross-language smoke snippet in /examples/smoke/ 5) Add link to SDK changelog (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases).

ben: i'll open PR 4337 for the TS change this afternoon. cc @jordan for review.

mike: i'll open PR 4338 for Go. leaving the pagination param name as `cursor` to match API.

jordan: i'll do a quick pass on the Python sample to add a small resume note and add a test case to examples/streams/test_resume.py.

sara: timeline? enterprise docs release tomorrow — we should land these before EOD.

ben: aiming to have TS PR ready in ~3 hours.

mike: Go PR will be up in ~4 hours.

jordan: i'll push the Python tweak in 1 hour. if anyone needs help with wording for the resume note ping me.

ellie: once PRs are up, i'll do a sanity cross-lang comparison and leave inline comments.

sara: thanks team. I'll coordinate release note blurb. :shipit: 

docs-bot: Automated check: PR 4321 merged, PR 4337 (TS) not yet, PR 4338 (Go) not yet.

ben: PR 4337 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4337

mike: PR 4338 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4338

jordan: pushed python-test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4339 

sara: left a tiny wording nit on 4321 but it's optional. can we at least have streaming examples consistent across the three languages for the release?

both: yep.

mike: updated PR 4338 with sample; requesting review from @ellie and @jordan.

ben: updated PR 4337; requesting review from @sara and @jordan.

ellie: quick check done, left two small suggestions in TS PR about `stream()` naming to match SDK; otherwise LGTM.

jordan: reviewed python test and TS; small tweak to TS doc comment — pushed suggestion.

sara: i'm going to bundle the release blurb and mark as docs release v0.13.1 in the notes.

docs-bot: Release note draft: "Align streaming/pagination samples across SDKs; add resume/retry guidance for streaming endpoints."

jordan: awesome. closing thread — please ping here if anything blocks landing before EOD. :thumbsup:
